output.title: BR-04 JPY lines are converted and rounded one by one to whole yen, and the total is the sum of the rounded lines @critical
output.data_choice: Sakura invoices in JPY, which has no decimals. One line rounds down (4,871.10) and the other rounds up (142,885.60), so a wrong conversion or rounding would change what the page shows. The total alone would not separate summing rounded lines from rounding the sum (147,756.70 also rounds to 147,757), so the per-line amounts carry the rule.
